text: Managing a team is not easy, but good communication makes a big difference. A leader should explain goals clearly and make sure everyone understands their role. Delegation is also important, because you cannot do everything alone. Trust your team members and give them tasks that match their skills. Regular feedback helps people improve and feel valued, which increases motivation. When conflicts happen, listen to both sides calmly and look for a fair solution. Finally, remember to appreciate good work and keep a positive atmosphere, because a motivated team works better together and achieves more.
